title: Darkbloom switch cost: recovery curve over 47 recorded slots, one M4 Max (EXPLORATORY)

statement.criteria: EXPLORATORY, retrospective: rules declared in docs/CAMPAIGN-2026-09-27.md section 2 before the analysis was run, but the slot archive already existed, so this is NOT pre-registered and carries no prereg link. Produced by analysis/switch_cost.py over 47 non-dry recorded slots from 7 campaigns, Apple M4 Max 64GB 40-core, macOS 27.0, Darkbloom 0.9.9-0.9.10. Revenue divided only by exposure observed inside a slot window; base_reward excluded. The cold-vs-resident split is POST-HOC and labelled so in the payload.
